title: ShopBot tries to pay twice for one yes
story: ShopBot gets one allow for Asha's groceries and pays. Then it tries to make a second Payment on the same allow. The Guard refuses with DECISION_ALREADY_PAID: one yes means one Payment, so an assistant can't turn a single approval into repeated charges.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Order rice and dal for the week.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Rice and dal at FreshMart come to INR 1,200. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: FreshMart has a second batch of the same order. I'll pay for that one on the same approval.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: AgentPay Guard refused the second payment: that approval was already used. I'll ask again if you want the second batch. The first payment is going through.

what_to_notice: The second create_payment carries a new idempotency key, so it is a new request, not a retry, and the Guard refuses it with DECISION_ALREADY_PAID. Only the first Payment exists, and it is captured. To pay again ShopBot must ask for a new Decision, which counts against the limits like any other.
